# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the [latest release](https://github.com/rhadlock/EndlessMap/releases/latest) for each game is supported; fixes go
into the next release.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't post a security problem in a public issue. Report it privately instead: **Security** tab > **Report a
vulnerability**, or [this link](https://github.com/rhadlock/EndlessMap/security/advisories/new). Only you and the
maintainer see the report, and the answer comes there.

Endless Map runs inside the game's add-on sandbox, reads no messages from other players and makes no network
connections. The likeliest problems are fake copies of the add-on and the automation that publishes releases here.

## Safe downloads

Endless Map is published only on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/endless-map) and under this
repository's [Releases](https://github.com/rhadlock/EndlessMap/releases). A copy from anywhere else is not ours.
